sections.content: Units: px (fixed), % (parent-relative), em (element font-size), rem (root font-size), vw/vh (viewport), ch/ex (character-based), and math functions calc/min/max/clamp.
Prefer rem for typography, %/fr for layout proportions, vw/vh sparingly (mobile URL bars shift vh). clamp() gives fluid sizing without media queries.
Key points: 1rem = root font-size (16px default), em compounds when nested, and vmin/vmax pick the smaller/larger viewport dimension.
Summary: CSS Units — practice the example by changing values and predicting the output before running it.
